title: Two Young Boys Outside Brick House, 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot photograph showing two young boys sitting on the ground outside a brick home. The younger child wears a knit cap with a pom-pom and a warm cardigan, while the older boy wears a winter hat and coat with thick gloves. A wooden chair on the porch and a barrel are visible against the brick wall in the background. The photo offers a candid glimpse into Depression-era American childhood.
